concerns.text: The hierarchical bootstrap described in Phase 5 ("outer resample draws datasets with replacement (10 000 draws). For each sampled dataset, inner resample draws from its permutation‑based error‑rate or power estimates (1 000 draws)") results in on the order of 10 000 × 1 000 = 10 M resamples per transformation. With four transformations this exceeds 40 M resamples, which is unlikely to complete within the 6‑hour runtime limit of the GitHub Actions free‑tier CPU runner (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM). This compute demand makes the current plan infeasible under the platform’s free‑compute constraints.
